package.name: zero_description
package.description: Bimanual workstation descriptions for project ZERO: reBot, ViperX 300s and Unitree G1. Ships BOTH descriptions that mujoco_ros2_control needs: a URDF for ros2_control/TF and an MJCF for the MuJoCo model. Both are generated by scripts/gen_{urdf,scene}.py from a single shared layout module, and scripts/check_parity.py asserts they agree on joint names.
